items.title: Endless Pools Makes a Difference during “SWIMTember”
items.summary: When Masco President and CEO, Jon Nudi, declared September 2025 a Month of Service, the small but mighty team at Endless Pools—a division of Watkins Wellness based in Aston, PA—dreamed up the concept of “SWIMTember,” a month dedicated to leveraging their passion around water safety to make a positive impact in the community. SWIMTember challenged employees to swim in an Endless Pool in order to earn donations for the local YMCA. With teams competing under the leadership of six captains, the grand total came to 235 swims, which raised enough funds to provide free swim lessons for more than 150…

items.title: Behr Participates in Nationwide Cleanup of Military Cemeteries
items.summary: During the Masco Month of Service in September, over 60 Behr team members joined thousands of volunteers from across the country on the anniversary of 9/11 for a nationwide beautification of military cemeteries led by Behr’s nonprofit partner Carry The Load. Employees from over a dozen states participated, cleaning headstones at 15 locations spanning from Brooklyn’s Cypress Hills National Cemetery (NY) to San Bruno’s Golden Gate National Cemetery (CA). Matt Knight, Vice President of Sales- West Region and the leader of Behr’s Veterans Employee Group, volunteered at Riverside National Cemetery in CA. “This experience is incredibly rewarding in many ways.…

items.title: Behr Paint Supports Veterans through Industry Partnership
items.summary: In July, Behr Paint Company announced a new nationwide initiative in partnership with the Painting Contractors Association (PCA) to support U.S. veterans and transitioning service members as they begin or grow careers in the professional painting industry. Through this program, 100 veterans will receive a scholarship for a complimentary first-year PCA membership—granting full access to PCA’s robust network of education, training, and business resources. In addition, recipients will be paired with personalized mentors, including PCA member volunteers and members of the Behr Veterans Network. Behr is also offering event scholarships to 25 veterans, covering admission and a travel stipend to…

items.title: Hansgrohe Presents Hire Heroes USA Military Spouse Award
items.summary: 2025 marks Masco’s eighth year of partnership with nonprofit Hire Heroes USA, which helps connect U.S. military members, veterans and their spouses to successful, rewarding career paths. In May, Masco had the honor of sponsoring the Military Spouse Award at the 3rd Annual Hire Heroes USA Empowerment Gala in Atlanta. This award recognizes a military spouse who has served as a silent hero for the military community with their selfless sacrifices and unwavering commitment. Congratulations to this year’s recipient, Verda Smith! Team members from our Georgia-based Hansgrohe Group had a great time celebrating at the event and presenting the award.…

items.title: Supporting Detroit’s Next Generation of Aviation Professionals
items.summary: For the past 3 years, Masco’s Flight Operations team has supported the Golightly Career & Technical Center’s Flight Training and Aviation Technology course for students in the Detroit Public Schools Community District. The course focuses on careers piloting either drones or airplanes, giving first-year students hours of hands-on training to be able to earn a FAA Remote Pilot Certificate, which allows them to fly drones for profit. Select students can return for a second year focused on passing the FAA Private Pilot Written Exam, the first required step to becoming a professional pilot. items.title: Behr Paint Employees Participate in 9/11 National Day of Service
items.summary: In September, a group of Behr Paint team members took advantage of Behr Cares hours by volunteering with Carry the Load Foundation, which held a National Day of Service to commemorate the anniversary of 9/11. 20 Behr Paint employees volunteered to clean headstones and beautify the grounds at ten different military cemeteries throughout the US, stretching from Tahoma National Cemetery in Kent, WA, to Cyprus Hills National Cemetery in Brooklyn, NY. “I was humbled to shake hands and thank the veterans for their service, seeing how they are still serving those who sacrificed everything for us,” says Chris Swaney, Regional…

items.title: Masco Volunteers at Financial Literacy Camp
items.summary: In late June, members of the Masco Finance and IT teams volunteered with nonprofit Detroit Impact on the first day of their Young Investor Summer Camp, part of the Money Matters for Youth program. The program’s mission is to teach children of all ages the fundamentals of economics and financial responsibility, with all camp activities designed to promote financial literacy and awareness. The Masco volunteers assisted with the camp’s “Adulting” activity, also known as the Reality Store. items.title: Delta Faucet Company Celebrates Day of Service
items.summary: In early June, Delta Faucet Company held a day of service in which their employees volunteered for a variety of community-oriented activities. At Delta Faucet Company headquarters in Indianapolis, employees worked with Greater Indy Habitat for Humanity to construct wall panels, which will be assembled into a home for a local family. “This marks our 25th year partnering with Habitat for Humanity and the 25th home our employees are helping to build. items.title: Masco Employees Return to “Big Give Back” Event
items.summary: In April, employees from Masco Headquarters rolled up their sleeves at the MCHS Family of Services’ second annual “Big Give Back” event. MCHS Family of Services is a child welfare agency providing foster care and adoption, transitional living, child abuse prevention and community wellness programs. Meeting in Redford, MI, at MCHS’ historic campus, the Masco team cleaned up two of the outdoor recreation areas to be ready for kids’ use as the weather warms up. items.title: Masco Partners with Local News to Collect Children’s Books
items.summary: This year, Masco is partnering with the Detroit news station WDIV to broadcast a special series in Masco World Headquarters’ home region of Southeast Michigan. Through televised segments airing weekly on WDIV Detroit, the year-long series, called Go 4 It, is celebrating good news by shining a spotlight on the philanthropic impact made by nonprofit organizations, corporations, and individuals. In March, to celebrate Reading Month, WDIV broadcast live as Masco HQ hosted a drive-through book collection to benefit Detroit Public Schools.
